entities.name: Enlightenment Thought
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The intellectual movement of the 17th–18th centuries emphasizing reason, individual liberty, religious tolerance, and scientific progress. Enlightenment thinkers — Voltaire, Locke, Montesquieu, Kant — challenged traditional authority and inspired democratic revolutions worldwide.
